{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in R&D expenses over the past year, scaled by total assets, and then calculate the change in this ratio over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with increasing R&D investments may be more likely to experience future growth, and the momentum in this measure can indicate the success of these investments", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of cost of goods sold to total sales, and then calculate the standard deviation of this ratio over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more stable supply chains may be better positioned to manage costs and deliver returns to shareholders", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the change in inventory turnover over the past year, where inventory turnover is calculated as cost of goods sold divided by average inventory", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating inventory turnover may be experiencing improving operational efficiency", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets, using data from the firm's 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face future costs and reputational risks that can negatively impact returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Consistency", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of the year-over-year change in total employees over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with consistent employee growth may be better positioned to deliver stable returns to shareholders", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of customer concentration, using data on the firm's top 5 customers", "rationale": "Firms with high customer concentration may face future risks and uncertainties that can negatively impact returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Tax Loss Carryforward", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of tax loss carryforwards to total assets, using data from the firm's 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with high tax loss carryforwards may be able to reduce future tax liabilities and increase returns to shareholders", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Funding Status", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of pension plan assets to pension plan liabilities, using data from the firm's 10-K filings", "rationale": "Firms with well-funded pension plans may face lower future liabilities and increased financial flexibility", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Compensation Alignment", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of executive compensation to total firm value, using data from the firm's proxy filings", "rationale": "Firms with executive compensation packages that are aligned with shareholder interests may be more likely to deliver returns to shareholders", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director Busyness", "construction": "Calculate the average number of board seats held by each director, using data from the firm's proxy filings", "rationale": "Firms with busy directors may face future governance risks and decreased board effectiveness", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
